en: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Accumulating)

manager: BlackRock Asset Management Ireland Limited (fund: iShares VII plc)
legal_form: UCITS ETF, sub-fund (share class USD Accumulating) of iShares VII plc, Ireland; physical replication ('Product Structure: Physical', 'Methodology: Physical Replication'); 'UK Reporting Status: Yes'; fund launch date 18-May-2010, share class launch date 19-May-2010; benchmark 'S&P 500 Index'. Its Tel Aviv line: number 1159250, ticker iSFF702, in shekels, 0.07% (BlackRock's Israel brochure (library 5fae6c1d0933c1bc, p. 1, 2026-10-01)). The same share class bought abroad is record ie00b5bmr087.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF, USD (Accumulating), CSPX, factsheet 'September 2026' (performance and net assets as at 30-Sep-2026, all other data as at 05-Oct-2026), iShares VII plc / BlackRock, p. 1 'Product information': 'Total Expense Ratio : 0.07%'

fixed_management.notes: Total expense ratio (TER) of the share class as the factsheet prints it; a UCITS TER is the all-in ongoing charge, so the Israeli fee layers (variable fee, trustee fee) do not exist here (ETF-27: 'אין דמי ניהול משתנים'). The factsheet is marketing material dated September 2026, data as at 05-Oct-2026; the KIID/prospectus was not opened.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF U.S. Dollar (Accumulating), CSPX, factsheet 'October 2026', iShares VII plc, p. 2 'Calendar year performance'

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The factsheet 'October 2026' (marketing material; performance as at 31-Oct-2026) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Performance is shown on a Net Asset Value (NAV) basis, with gross income reinvested where applicable', in US dollars. Benchmark as the document names it: 'S&P 500 Index'. The factsheet does not say whether the S&P 500 figures are net or gross of withholding tax on dividends; the fund's own Israeli prospectus annex (p. 9) says the fund follows the index's net total return, so the benchmark is recorded as net (tracking_record.benchmark). This Tel Aviv line trades units of the same share class, ISIN IE00B5BMR087, as its Israeli prospectus annex names it (library 8862b7b68914c4cc); the figures are that share class's NAV returns in US dollars, the same as record ie00b5bmr087, not a return in shekels. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).
